properties.multipart_transport: upload/replace bypass apiClient: local multipartRequest() sends FormData via raw fetch with the Bearer token, no 401 refresh/retry, and throws a plain Error (not ApiError)

properties.base_url: config.apiBaseUrl from lib/config (NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, default http://localhost:8000/api); request URL = apiBaseUrl + endpoint
properties.auth_header: Content-Type: application/json on every request; Authorization: Bearer <getAccessToken()> added when a token exists and auth !== false (login/refresh/logout pass auth=false)
properties.token_refresh: On HTTP 401 for an authed, not-yet-retried request: refreshAccessToken() POSTs {refresh_token} to apiBaseUrl + /auth/refresh with raw fetch, sharing one in-flight promise across concurrent callers; on success setTokens(access_token, refresh_token ?? previous) and the request is retried once; on failure or missing refresh token clearTokens() (notifies onTokensCleared listeners) and the 401 surfaces as ApiError
properties.total_count: getList() reads the X-Total-Count response header: total = Number(header), falling back to items.length when the header is absent; returns {items, total}
properties.error_handling: Non-2xx throws ApiError(message, status); message = detail string, or the joined msg values of a validation detail array, else 'HTTP <status>'
properties.debug_logging: NEXT_PUBLIC_DEBUG === '1' logs console.info('[api]', method, url, status, durationMs)
